column1: What should remain independent before consulting AI?
column2:
Your decision question and initial interpretation, so the generated response can be compared with a human starting point. This is an authored learning workflow, not a validated anti-bias guarantee.

Evidence context: https://doi.org/10.1098/rsos.241776

column1: What two checks does a citation require?
column2:
Verify that the reference exists and that its actual content supports the specific claim.

Evidence context: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12935541/

column1: What should happen when the supplied excerpt omits a method?
column2:
Record it as unreported in the supplied material and seek the relevant full methods, protocol or supplement; do not fill the gap by assumption.

Evidence context: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12644243/

column1: How should AI-extracted numbers be checked?
column2:
Compare event, numerator, denominator, units and time horizon with the original table, then independently recalculate.

Evidence context: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12644243/

column1: Does retrieval-backed output establish a complete literature search?
column2:
No. Discovery coverage and source selection still need methods appropriate to the question.

Evidence context: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12935541/; https://www.cochrane.org/about-us/news/cochrane-launches-innovative-study-assess-ai-tools-evidence-synthesis

column1: What belongs in an AI assistance log?
column2:
Tool/version, date, task, supplied material, prompt, retrieval scope, output checks and corrections; follow the relevant reporting policy.

Evidence context: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12644243/; https://www.icmje.org/recommendations/browse/artificial-intelligence/ai-use-by-authors.html

column1: Can a confidential manuscript be uploaded merely because you are its reviewer?
column2:
No. Follow journal policy; when confidentiality cannot be assured, explicit author permission is required before such sharing.

Evidence context: https://www.icmje.org/recommendations/browse/artificial-intelligence/ai-use-by-editors.html

column1: Who retains responsibility for a submitted AI-assisted appraisal?
column2:
The human author or reviewer; AI does not take responsibility for accuracy, attribution or interpretation.

Evidence context: https://www.icmje.org/recommendations/browse/artificial-intelligence/ai-use-by-authors.html
